name: SkillSwap
tagline: Lessons, commissions and help from creative people in the community.
description: SkillSwap is a place for creative people to teach and sell their skills. Artists can offer free drawing lessons, low-cost tutoring and affordable commissions, and the same goes for writing, music, programming, animation and more. Free lessons are listed alongside paid ones, not tucked away behind them.
features: Creator pages with portfolio, services, prices and availability
One-to-one tutoring, group workshops and recorded tutorials
Artwork commissions with examples, prices and delivery estimates
Categories that grow beyond drawing: writing, music, code, video and games

credits.comment: Empty developer and publisher mean the central identity in brand/identity.json.
